messages:
alex_marketing: Heads-up — prepping launch copy and benchmark claims. Need final bench artifacts & repro from runtime. Specifically: raw sample payloads, warmup protocol (script and tokens/worker), quantized + fp16 variants, seed keys, per-run logs (including tail latencies), and the exact commands used. Deadline EOD Wed. Can you help? @jamie_runtime @sanjay_eng

jamie_runtime: On it. Quick clarifying Q: which model tag & which quantized variant should we package as the 'launch' artifact?

alex_marketing: Calling out rwd-gpt-large:v3 (fp16) and the 4-bit q8 variant we demoed in slides. Also need the warmup traffic script and the number of warmup tokens per worker.

sanjay_eng: For the q8 run we used quant profile 'q_kv4-v2' with per-layer clipping. Will confirm the exact config file. Also — do you need per-request KV-cache hit stats or just end-to-end p50/p95/p99 numbers?

alex_marketing: Both, if possible. Marketing needs p50/p95/p99 + coldstart vs warmed percentiles and a few sample outputs per slice for quality checks. Also include provenance: who ran it, timestamp, and commit hash.

ci-bot: artifact-uploader: new artifacts uploaded at s3://redwood-bench/artifacts/1795001234/ (access: rw-marketing, eng-runtime).

jamie_runtime: I'll assemble a handoff pack: runbook.md, warmup.sh, docker image tag, bench-run.json (traffic profile), and raw logs.zip. Quick question on embargo: should artifacts be embargoed until our launch date or can eng-runtime publish to shared bucket now?

alex_marketing: Embargo until 2026-04-10 00:00 UTC. Please mark artifacts 'embargoed' and share an expiring signed link. Also include the exact curl invocation you used so we can paste into docs, e.g.:

curl -X POST https://runtime.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-gpt-large:v3","input":"<sample>", "max_tokens":128, "stream":false}'

Thanks.

sanjay_eng: Noted. We'll include that plus a minimal docker-compose snippet for local repro (GPU required).

jamie_runtime: Plan: run a focused sanity rerun on the q8 variant emphasizing long-context (8k) and conversation-turn tail cases. ETA for the artifact bundle: tomorrow noon UTC. I'll also attach notebooks for the percentile-stability analysis (bootstrap CI).

linda_prodops: Please add customer-success to the share list so they can triage inbound leads after launch.

alex_marketing: One more ask: marketing wants 10 'representative' output samples per traffic slice (short prompt, long prompt, code-gen, chat). Include variant id and seed. Export CSV with columns: slice, seed, variant, output_snippet, tokens, latency_ms.

jamie_runtime: Will do. CSV + JSON index describing slices/seeds. Seeds used in the runs: 42-51. We'll also publish checksum manifest.

sanjay_eng: We'll attach a short note on batching/warmup knobs that materially affect latency, e.g. batch_size=8, batch_timeout_ms=10, prefix_cache=true.

alex_marketing: Great — if you drop the link when ready I'll spot-check outputs against the slide claims. cc @jamie_runtime @linda_prodops

jamie_runtime: Link (embargoed): https://s3.redwood.ai/embargoed/bench-handshake-1795001234.tar.gz (permissions: rw-marketing, eng-runtime; expires 2026-04-10). Checklist uploaded to the bundle.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: smoke-rerun job #824 queued (tags: quant-q8, long-context). Logs will appear in the artifact bundle.

jamie_runtime: Smoke rerun finished. Quick summary: warmed p50=36ms, p95=92ms, p99=210ms. Coldstart median ~480ms. Uploaded: logs.zip, samples.csv, bench-run.json, reproducibility-notes.md. Flagged one outlier at iteration 17 — small IO hiccup; details in logs.

alex_marketing: Thanks! I'll spot-check the CSV outputs and latencies and confirm we can use the p95/p99 in the launch doc. Appreciate the quick turnaround :tada:
